name: Rejection Reason 91 Code
definition: Specifies a reason why the instruction has a rejected status.

SAFE.name: Safekeeping Account Rejection
SAFE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid message sender's safekeeping account.

IPOS.name: Insufficient Threshold Position
IPOS.definition: Position is less than required threshold.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Transaction/instruction received after the account servicer's specified deadline.

IPOA.name: Missing Or Invalid POA
IPOA.definition: Missing or invalid power of attorney.

RBIS.name: Rejected By Issuer Or Registrar
RBIS.definition: Issuer or registrar has rejected the instruction.

LACK.name: Lackof Securities
LACK.definition: Instructed position exceeds the eligible balance.

FULL.name: Missing Beneficiary Owner Details
FULL.definition: Rejected due to missing beneficiary owner details.

DUPL.name: Duplicate Instruction
DUPL.definition: Instruction is rejected due to duplicate business message identifier.

LIST.name: Invalid Vote In Favour In Group Listing
LIST.definition: Instruction is invalid due to multiple resolutions instructed as vote "For” and belonging to the same listing group resolution label number.

NOSL.name: Not Registered In In Stock Ledger
NOSL.definition: Invalid instruction as the shareholder or its delegate is not registered in the company stock ledger book.

PMNS.name: Participation Method Not Supported
PMNS.definition: Instruction rejected due to the method of participation not supported by the account servicer.

IPED.name: Instruction Prior To Entitlement Date
IPED.definition: Instruction was received prior to entitlement date.

NACD.name: Not Accepted Email Address Missing
NACD.definition: Instruction to virtually attend meeting is rejected due to missing attendee email address.

EFDM.name: Missing Or Incorrect Entitlement Fixing Date
EFDM.definition: Entitlement fixing date is missing or incorrect.

ADIM.name: Additional Disclosure Information Missing
ADIM.definition: (I)CSD failed to receive (from underlying) or provide (to the issuer agent) the disclosure information required.

MINC.name: Missing Investor Classification Details
MINC.definition: Classification submitted in the instruction does not match the investor classification in the notification.

DSEC.name: Invalid Security
DSEC.definition: Unrecognised or invalid financial instrument identification.
